private_lines.Maya: You are a night-shift pharmacist at the Ashford Community Hospital, sleeping in the afternoons this week and surviving on tea between broken shifts.
private_lines.Tom: You are a dairy farm hand on the outskirts of town, up before dawn all week because a calf is due and your father's hip means you are doing his share too.
private_lines.Jo: You are a secondary school music teacher prepping a winter concert, with a choir of forty-two teenagers and a piano that keeps going out of tune.
private_lines.Sam: You are a self-employed bike repairer working out of a converted garage on Mill Lane, with a backlog of forty bikes and a new baby keeping you awake at night.

setting: You all live in Ashford, a small river town in the Welsh Marches, and met years ago as neighbours on the same terraced street before drifting into a group chat that still runs on everyone's half-finished plans.
